# Lab 14.1: Generate Text Embeddings

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn text into embeddings with AI.EMBED, using a Vertex AI model and a built-in BigQuery model, and store them in a table.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab14</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Embed one sentence.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  ARRAY_LENGTH(AI.EMBED('How do I partition a table?', endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result) AS vertex_dims,
  ARRAY_LENGTH(AI.EMBED('How do I partition a table?', model =&gt; 'embeddinggemma-300m').result) AS builtin_dims;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Both return 768 numbers. The built-in model runs on BigQuery slots, not on Vertex AI.

3. **[SQL] Embed 20,000 Stack Overflow titles.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab14.so_questions AS
SELECT id, title, tags
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
WHERE tags LIKE '%google-bigquery%' OR tags LIKE '%sql%'
LIMIT 20000;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab14.so_emb AS
SELECT id, title, tags, AI.EMBED(title, endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb
FROM lab14.so_questions;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Check for failed rows.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT COUNTIF(ARRAY_LENGTH(emb) = 768) AS ok, COUNTIF(emb IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(emb) = 0) AS failed
FROM lab14.so_emb;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

   About 20,000 × 768 floats is over 100 MB, which is large enough for a vector index later.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `AI.EMBED` | One vector per text |
| Dimensions | 768 for both models |
| Built-in model | Runs on BigQuery slots |
| Table | `lab14.so_emb` with an `emb` column |
